Journal EP-4101: restate the worked numbers, name one claim you refuse (commercial standardized 6G, vendor cert grant, unmerged device-os PR, fabricated field trial), and keep prose specific to this week's lab_id and ticket IDs. On an nRF52840-class part, 1 MB of flash spans 0x00000000-0x000FFFFF and 256 KB of SRAM spans 0x20000000-0x2003FFFF; the first vector-table word is the initial stack pointer and the second is the reset handler address, so a wrong table offset boots into garbage before main() ever runs.

lesson.body_md: ForgeSense Subsystem Bench ticket EP-4303: I2C timing — address, frequency, and NACK recovery. SSD1306-class address 0x3C at 100 kHz with explicit NACK plan. A 7-bit address of 0x3C appears on the wire as 0x78 for a write and 0x79 for a read; an address NACK means the device is absent or the address is wrong, and a slave holding SDA low is released by clocking SCL up to nine times and then issuing a STOP.
